SELECT (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=sales_orders.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS organizationGroupId, (SELECT name FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=sales_orders.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS organizationGroupName, sales_orders.id AS id, sales_orders.order_date AS orderDate, IF(is_pos=1,(SELECT sales_order_id FROM sales_order_receipts WHERE sales_order_id=sales_orders.id),sales_orders.id) AS invoiceId, IF(is_pos=1,(SELECT receipt_code FROM sales_order_receipts WHERE sales_order_id=sales_orders.id),sales_orders.so_code) AS invoiceCode, memo AS memo, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS warehouseName, sales_orders.total_amount-IFNULL(sales_orders.discount,0)+IFNULL(sales_orders.total_vat,0)-IFNULL(sales_orders.total_deposit,0) AS totalAmount, sales_orders.balance AS balance, IF(balance>0 AND DATEDIFF(now(),due_date)>0,DATEDIFF(now(),due_date),'.') AS aging, sales_orders.status AS status FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id
UNION
SELECT (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=credit_memos.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS organizationGroupId, (SELECT name FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=credit_memos.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS organizationGroupName, credit_memos.id AS id, credit_memos.order_date AS orderDate, credit_memos.id AS invoiceId, credit_memos.cm_code AS invoiceCode, credit_memos.note AS memo, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS organizationName, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS warehouseName, (credit_memos.total_amount-IFNULL(credit_memos.discount,0)+IFNULL(credit_memos.mark_up,0)+IFNULL(credit_memos.total_vat,0))*-1 AS totalAmount, (credit_memos.balance)*-1 AS balance, IF(balance>0 AND DATEDIFF(now(),due_date)>0,DATEDIFF(now(),due_date),'.') AS aging, credit_memos.status AS status FROM credit_memos LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = credit_memos.customer_id
ORDER BY organizationGroupName, orderDate ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT sales_orders.id FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id
UNION
SELECT credit_memos.id FROM credit_memos LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = credit_memos.customer_id
) AS result
